امتحنتا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَحَنَتَا (imtaḥanatā) /im.ta.ħa.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# اُمْتُحِنَتَا (umtuḥinatā) /um.tu.ħi.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
